sentences.en: In today's class I'm going to talk about marine archaeology, the branch of archaeology focusing on human interaction with the sea, lakes and rivers.
sentences.zh: In今天的课上，我将讲解海洋考古学，即考古学中专注于人类与海洋、湖泊及河流相互关系的分支。

sentences.en: It's the study of ships, cargoes, shipping facilities, and other physical remains.
sentences.zh: 它是对船舶、货物、航运设施以及其他实物遗存的研究。

sentences.en: I'll give you an example, then go on to show how this type of research is being transformed by the use of the latest technology.
sentences.zh: 我先举一个例子，然后进一步说明这类研究如何因最新技术的应用而发生变革。

sentences.en: Atlit-Yam was a village on the coast of the eastern Mediterranean, which seems to have been thriving until around 7,000 BC.
sentences.zh: 阿特利特-亚姆（Atlit-Yam）是东地中海沿岸的一座村庄，似乎一直繁荣发展至约公元前7000年左右。

sentences.en: The residents kept cattle, caught fish and stored grain.
sentences.zh: 当地居民饲养牛群、捕捞鱼类并储存谷物。

sentences.en: They had wells for fresh water, many of their houses were built around a courtyard and were constructed of stone.
sentences.zh: 他们开凿了淡水井，许多房屋围绕庭院建造，并以石材构筑。

sentences.en: The village contained an impressive monument: seven half-tonne stones a standing in a semicircle around a spring, that might have been used for ceremonial purposes.
sentences.zh: 该村拥有一处令人印象深刻的遗迹：七块半吨重的石块呈半圆形环绕一处泉眼排列，可能曾用于仪式目的。

sentences.en: Atlit-Yam may have been destroyed swiftly by tsunami, or climate change may have caused glaciers to melt and sea levels to rise, flooding the village gradually.
sentences.zh: 阿特利特-亚姆或许曾被海啸迅速摧毁；又或者，气候变化导致冰川融化、海平面上升，使村庄逐渐被海水淹没。

sentences.en: Whatever the cause, it now lies ten metres below the surface of the Mediterranean, buried under sand at the bottom of the sea.
sentences.zh: 无论成因为何，该遗址如今位于地中海海面以下十米深处，掩埋于海底沙层之下。

sentences.en: It's been described as the largest and best preserved prehistoric settlement ever found on the seabed.
sentences.zh: 它被描述为迄今在海底发现的最大、保存最完好的史前聚落。

sentences.en: For marine archaeologists, Atlit-Yam is a treasure trove.
sentences.zh: 对海洋考古学家而言，阿特利特-亚姆是一座宝藏。

sentences.en: Research on the buildings, tools and 032 the human remains has revealed how the bustling village once functioned. and even what diseases some of its residents suffered from.
sentences.zh: 对建筑、工具及人类遗骸的研究揭示了这座繁华村庄昔日的运作方式，甚至揭示出部分居民所患的疾病。

sentences.en: But of course this is only one small village, one window into a lost world.
sentences.zh: 但当然，这仅是一座小型村庄，只是窥探那个失落世界的一扇窗口。

sentences.en: For a fuller picture, researchers need more sunken settlements, but the hard part is finding them.
sentences.zh: 要获得更全面的认识，研究人员需要更多沉没的聚落遗址，而难点恰恰在于如何发现它们。

sentences.en: Underwater research used to require divers to find shipwrecks or artefacts, but in the second half of the twentieth century, various types of underwater vehicles were developed, some controlled from a ship on the surface, and some of them autonomous, which means they don't need to be operated by a person.
sentences.zh: 过去，水下研究依赖潜水员搜寻沉船或人工制品；但自20世纪下半叶起，各类水下运载器相继问世——其中一些由水面船舶遥控操作，另一些则为自主式运载器（即无需人员实时操控）。

sentences.en: ELW Autonomous underwater vehicles, or AUVs, are used in the oil industry, for instance, to create maps of the seabed before rigs and pipelines are installed.
sentences.zh: 例如，自主式水下运载器（AUVs）已被应用于石油工业，在钻井平台和管道安装前绘制海底地形图。

sentences.en: To navigate they use sensors, such as compasses and sonar.
sentences.zh: 它们依靠罗盘、声呐等传感器实现导航。

sentences.en: Until relatively recently they were very expensive, and so heavy that they had to be launched from a large vessel with a winch.
sentences.zh: 直到相对较近的时期，这些运载器仍极为昂贵，且重量过大，必须借助大型船舶配备的绞车才能布放。

sentences.en: But the latest AUVs are much easier to manoeuvre - they can be launched from the shore or a small ship.
sentences.zh: 但最新的自主式水下运载器操纵起来容易得多——可直接从海岸或小型船舶上布放。

sentences.en: And they're much cheaper, which makes them more accessible to research teams.
sentences.zh: 同时成本大幅降低，使科研团队更容易获取并使用它们。

sentences.en: They're also very sophisticated.
sentences.zh: 此外，它们的技术也更为先进。

sentences.en: They can communicate with each other and, for example, work out the most efficient way to survey a site, or to find particular objects on the seabed.
sentences.zh: 它们能彼此通信，例如协同规划最高效的遗址勘测路径，或共同搜寻海底特定目标物。

sentences.en: Field tests show the approach can work.
sentences.zh: 实地测试表明，这种方案切实可行。

sentences.en: For example, in a trial in 2015, three AUVs searched for wrecks at Marzamemi, off the coast of Sicily.
sentences.zh: 例如，在2015年一次试验中，三台自主式水下运载器在西西里岛沿海马尔扎梅尼（Marzamemi）海域搜寻沉船。

sentences.en: The site is the final resting place of an ancient Roman ship, which sank in the sixth century AD while ferrying prefabricated marble elements for the construction of an early church.
sentences.zh: 该遗址是一艘古罗马船舶的最终停泊地；该船于公元六世纪沉没，当时正运送预制大理石构件，用于修建一座早期教堂。

sentences.en: The AUVs mapped the area in detail, finding other ships carrying columns of the same material.
sentences.zh: 这些自主式水下运载器对该区域进行了精细测绘，还发现了其他装载同类石柱的沉船。

sentences.en: Creating an internet in the sea for AUVs to communicate is no easy matter.
sentences.zh: 为自主式水下运载器构建海底‘互联网’绝非易事。

sentences.en: Wifi networks on land use electromagnetic waves, but in water these will only travel a few centimetres.
sentences.zh: 陆地上的Wi-Fi网络依靠电磁波传输，但在水中，电磁波仅能传播几厘米。

sentences.en: Instead, a more a complex mix IS of technologies is required.
sentences.zh: 因此，需采用更为复杂多元的技术组合。

sentences.en: For short distances, AUVs can share data using light.
sentences.zh: 短距离通信时，自主式水下运载器可利用光信号共享数据。

sentences.en: while acoustic waves are used to communicate over long distances.
sentences.zh: 而远距离通信则依赖声波。

sentences.en: But more creative solutions are also being developed, where an AUV working on the seabed offloads data to a second AUV, which then surfaces and beams the data home to the research team using a satellite.
sentences.zh: 此外，更具创造性的解决方案也在开发之中：例如，一台在海底作业的自主式水下运载器可将数据卸载给第二台运载器，后者随即上浮并通过卫星将数据传回科研团队。

sentences.en: There's also a system that enables AUVs to share information from seabed scans, and other data.
sentences.zh: 另有一套系统可支持自主式水下运载器共享海底扫描结果及其他数据。

sentences.en: So if an AUV surveying the seabed finds an intriguing object, it can share the it Audioscripts coordinates of the object - that is, its position - with nearby AUV that carries superior cameras, and arrange for that AUV to make a closer inspection of the object.
sentences.zh: 因此，若某台正在勘测海底的自主式水下运载器发现一件引人兴趣的物体，即可将其坐标（即精确位置）发送给邻近搭载更先进摄像设备的另一台运载器，并协调后者对该物体进行近距离细致检查。

sentences.en: Marine archaeologists are excited about the huge potential of these AUVs for their discipline.
sentences.zh: 海洋考古学家对自主式水下运载器为本学科带来的巨大潜力倍感振奋。

sentences.en: One site where they're going to be deployed is the Gulf of Baratti, off the Italian coast.
sentences.zh: 其中一处即将部署此类运载器的遗址是意大利沿岸的巴腊蒂湾（Gulf of Baratti）。

sentences.en: In 1974, a 2,000-year-old Roman vessel was discovered here, in 18 metres of water.
sentences.zh: 1974年，一艘拥有两千年历史的罗马船舶在此处18米深的水域被发现。

sentences.en: When it sank, it was carrying medical goods, in wooden or tin receptacles.
sentences.zh: 该船沉没时，正运载着盛装于木质或锡制容器中的医药用品。

sentences.en: Its cargo gives us insight into the treatments available all those years ago, including tablets that are thought to have been dissolved to form a cleansing liquid for the eves.
sentences.zh: 其货物为我们了解数千年前的医疗手段提供了线索，其中包括一些据信可溶于水、用以清洗眼睛的药片。

sentences.en: Other Roman ships went down nearby, taking their cargoes with them.
sentences.zh: 附近海域还有其他罗马船舶沉没，同样携带着各自的货物。

sentences.en: Some held huge pots made of terracotta.
sentences.zh: 一些容器是用赤陶制成的巨大罐子。

sentences.en: Some were used for transporting cargoes of olive oil, and others held wine.
sentences.zh: 一些容器用于运输橄榄油货物，另一些则用来盛装葡萄酒。

sentences.en: In many cases it's only these containers that remain, while the wooden ships have been buried under silt on the seabed.
sentences.zh: 在许多情况下，只有这些容器留存下来，而木制船只则被海底的淤泥掩埋了。
